about.title: Where Rantai's figures come from
about.lead: Every figure in Rantai can be traced to its source. This page lists the data sources, last retrieval times, formulas, rules, and the limitations we know of.
about.sourcesFailed: Source status failed to load. The formulas and rules below still apply.
about.weakest: Derived figures take the weakest label of their inputs, in the order official, proxy, estimate, then simulation. Example: a gap from official seats and estimated graduates is labelled estimate.
about.formulaNote: The constant of 32 students per class group comes from Kepmendikdasmen 14/2026. When grade 6 data per school is not available, expected graduates are estimated as total primary school students divided by 6 and labelled estimate.
about.location.1: The package name is normalised, then searched for village and district names from the official area list, including RT and RW when mentioned.
about.location.2: Candidates outside the implementing agency's city are dropped, because city-level agency offices work in their own city.
about.location.3: A single matching village gives a point at the centre of the village, marked as not exact. A single district gives the district area. Otherwise the location is recorded at city level.
about.location.4: Because the district is determined from the package name, budget figures per district are labelled proxy.
about.signals.lead: A signal is a data pattern worth asking about, not a conclusion. Each signal appears with its reason, comparison data, and room for the agency's right of reply.
about.signal.S-01: A tender or selection method with only one bidder. Does not apply to direct procurement or direct appointment.
about.signal.S-02: The HPS is above the third quartile plus 1.5 times the interquartile range of similar packages, with at least 8 comparisons.
about.signal.S-03: Three or more direct procurement packages from the same agency and category within 30 days, each at least 85% of the direct procurement limit.
about.signal.S-04: One vendor won at least 40% of package value in one category at one agency within one budget year, with at least 5 packages.
about.signal.S-05: More than 30 days past the scheduled finish, with a verified citizen report that the work is not finished.
about.media.rule: A media article is linked to a DPRD member only when their name appears together with "DPRD DKI" or their faction's name in the same headline or snippet. Rantai stores the headline, a one-sentence summary, the outlet name, the date, and the link, not the article text.
about.media.bias: Members who get more coverage will look more active. This feed is not a measure of performance.
about.limit.1: School admission is not limited by district boundaries, so district figures show local pressure, not a child's actual chances.
about.limit.2: MI graduates are not counted yet because madrasah student data is not available at the source.
about.limit.3: LPSE DKI tender details are closed to the public, so some plan chain links are recorded as broken.
about.limit.4: Some package names do not mention an area, so their location is only known at city level.
about.license.csv: Package CSV downloads per district include the source URL and retrieval date for every row. Package data comes from LPSE Pemprov DKI and SiRUP LKPP, processed by Rantai; credit those sources when reusing it.
about.license.code: Rantai's code is open on GitHub. Data derived from Opentender is released under the same ODbL license.
about.demo: Data marked as simulation is an example for demonstration and must not be quoted as fact.
about.formula.code:
calon_lulusan  = grade 6 primary students in the district
kursi_negeri   = total capacity of public junior high schools in the district
kursi_spmb     = total capacity of SPMB Bersama partner private junior high schools
kursi_madrasah = grade 7 MTs class groups x 32
kesenjangan    = calon_lulusan - kursi_negeri
rasio          = kursi_negeri / calon_lulusan
